title: BS application can I have my money back?
body: Idea would be great but app is not. Just a scam :( I took on life one cause I though it makes more sense if you wanna build good habits. Then after purchasing I realized it’s an empty shell with some meh advise, stupid built and you need to pay more money to access full content. Don’t know how they got 4 star but don’t fall for it. Test it 3 days for free and probably you’ll give up (be careful to stop auto subscription)
author: Bulkyfan

title: Terrible. So disappointed.
body: The idea is amazing. So amazing, I’m almost buy the complete edition without testing. I’m so happy I try first and pay only for the first week. I don’t stay in there for 5 minutes and I was tired. So boring, complicated. I wanna you suggest me stuffs to do, to organize, if I will need to tell you, what I’m gonna do, I just use the notes from the iPhone. Is the same stuff, but the design is better and for free. So sorry for the thing the app can be, but is not.
author: BetaNomoto

title: Saw their ad on Instagram and downloaded
body: Sadly not what I was expecting. The Instagram add suggested that it had something to do with personality types and useful habits that would be suggested depending on your personality type. It’s basically just an app, where you are supposed to post your daily habits. Deinstalled.
author: Aeniima
